title: Can India end the poverty caused by medical bills? Devi Shetty predicts a 50% cut in healthcare costs

title: AI is now Wall Street’s biggest nightmare: 87% of experts warn of risks to financial system, Fed survey finds
description: A recent survey conducted by the Federal Reserve reveals that artificial intelligence is perceived as the primary threat to financial stability. Participants voiced concerns regarding inflated equity prices and possible market corrections. The survey also emphasized cybersecurity threats from nation-states and the risks posed by AI models. Other issues included AI financing challenges and rising hedge fund leverage since 2013, though the overall financial system currently shows stability.
